title: A scheme morphism with closed embedding on underlying spaces is affine
statement: Let $g:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose its underlying continuous map is a homeomorphism of $|X|$ onto a closed subset of $|Y|$, equipped with the subspace topology. Then $g$ is an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism].
